selection.criterion: largest alpha whose VALIDATION per-client dMASE p90 stays <= 10% of the oracle skill margin, inside the derived airtime budget

disclosures: TOLERANCE BASIS. The operating point is chosen on validation, but the TOLERANCE is anchored to the smaller of the validation and test skill margins, so a test-derived scalar does influence selection. It is harmless in the direction that matters: the smaller margin is a TIGHTER bar and selects a MORE expensive operating point. Anchoring on the validation margin instead would have selected a cheaper alpha (6.57 pkt/day rather than 9.37 on this run). A leak that works against the result is not one that flatters it.

RMSE IS NON-MONOTONIC IN ALPHA. It improves slightly as the codec gets lossier before worsening. This is real and explicable: on silent hours the codec substitutes smooth predictions for spiky true values, clipping the tail that RMSE is dominated by. At RMSE/MAE around 10 the tail owns RMSE, so mild input smoothing acts as a regulariser. Stated rather than rounded away.
use_case: The scheme buys an hourly-refreshed look-back. Its value is confined to applications needing a SHORT-HORIZON forecast REFRESHED EVERY HOUR. For day-ahead scheduling a daily batch is adequate and this buys nothing. The gain is zero at the resync hour and is refresh_gain_lead1_by_issue_hour elsewhere.
limitations: Single chronological split, single seed, no rolling origin and no model confidence set. Point estimates, not margin claims.
The gain is confined to short-lead hourly-refresh applications and is zero at the resync hour.
Clock drift is unmodelled; deployment assumes an RTC or the daily downlink phase correction.
ACK loss is handled by a compiled-in robustness mode (sync_safe) that is not evaluated here; see eval/loss_sweep.py.
The DLinear variant is DLinear with log1p and per-window RevIN, not the original paper's global StandardScaler, so its MASE figures are not comparable with published ECL MSE/MAE tables.
The fixed periodic refresh baseline carries no L-inf guarantee; the packet-rate comparison against it does not capture that qualitative difference.
